request: Because the currently bound source/actor records do not establish a qualifying acquired provider for the preserved Weird held branch, authorize a Weird-only revision of PF182-B02 external-provider review to permit static authored-procedure review with explicitly conditional, non-gameplay grant inputs. This request changes no Weird incapacity rule and supplies no actual provider, actor acquisition or activation.

retainedRequirements.PF181-H05: Retain the source-qualified actual-gameplay provider/acquisition/activation requirement without exception.
retainedRequirements.incapacity: Do not infer consent, willingness, grant receipt, self-activation, or permission to take an Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, speak or move while Unconscious. Distinguish external delivery/receipt from recipient activation and from permission to act on a scheduled turn.
retainedRequirements.allOtherHolds: PF181-H01, H02, H08, H09, H10 and H11 and all current Weird qualifications remain unchanged.

proposedConditionalTests.expected: Deny gameplay activation before payment or state mutation; preserve source status/runtime gate.

proposedConditionalTests.input: Inject a clearly labeled non-gameplay conditional inserted-turn event into the exact preserved Weird active branch; do not assert any actual provider or acquisition.
proposedConditionalTests.expected: Preserve the existing 4d10 Weird family exposure, actual regular target START packet, regular-END WIS save, concentration and original absolute expiry. The conditional inserted interval adds no recurring packet, END save, recharge tick, Reaction refresh, Ready reset, resource refund or deadline extension. Subsequent ordinary and attached markers resolve once in their original order; full before/after state history, exact fork hashes, reversible operations and reverse traversal included.

proposedConditionalTests.input: Keep the preserved recipient actually Unconscious. Supply an explicit conditional external source-policy input for whether that source permits grant receipt; test both deny and permits-as-source-input branches without making either a campaign/source finding. Separately test recipient-initiated activation while Unconscious.
proposedConditionalTests.expected: A deny policy yields no receipt. A permitted external receipt does not itself wake the recipient, remove Incapacitated/Unconscious, imply consent, refresh budgets or permit voluntary Actions/Bonus Actions/Reactions/speech/movement. Any activation requiring recipient participation is denied before payment. Only an independently explicit provider rule may define a passive or externally scheduled resolution; no such rule is claimed.

proposedConditionalTests.input: Reuse exact preserved Weird attached-familiar/controller-phase branch plus the conditional inserted interval.
proposedConditionalTests.expected: No duplicate attached START/END or family exposure; retain actual controller relationship and next scheduled attached checkpoint. No independent familiar turn is created.
